mine.title: My automations
mine.description: What agents do for you at a set time, on a schedule or when something happens. Each automation runs with your rights.
mine.empty: You have not created an automation yet.

agent.title: Automations
agent.description: The automations this agent carries out for people of the organisation.

space.title: Automations in this space
space.description: Automations and event rules at channels and tickets of the space, as far as you see them.
space.empty: There is no automation here that you see.

kindHints.recurring: On a schedule, such as every weekday at 9.
kindHints.heartbeat: Go through a checklist at fixed intervals within active hours.
kindHints.event: When something happens in the space, such as a new ticket.

paused.owner: Paused: its owner may no longer run it
paused.failing: Paused: three runs in a row did not finish

outcomes.skipped_busy: Skipped: the previous run was still working
outcomes.skipped_paused_agent: Skipped: the agent was paused or unavailable
outcomes.skipped_budget: Skipped: a daily budget was reached
outcomes.skipped_policy: Skipped: the place was archived or closed to this AI
outcomes.skipped_depth: Skipped: the chain was too deep (depth 3)

detail.notFound: This automation does not exist, or you may not see it.

delete.title: Delete the automation?
delete.text: It will not run again. Its past runs stay as history; a run working right now ends as it would have.

takeOver.title: Take over the automation?
takeOver.text: You become its owner: it then runs with your rights and in your name, its runs use your budget, and approvals and questions come to you. A paused automation runs again.
takeOver.ownerUnable: Its owner may no longer run this automation, so it cannot be resumed. Whoever could create it can take it over.

form.description: An agent carries it out without being asked in a conversation, with your rights at the chosen place.

places.dm: My direct message with the agent

form.channelHint: Each term opens a thread of its own there. The agent must be a member of the space.
form.ticketHint: Such as HC-12. The ticket's thread is created on saving if it does not exist yet.
form.instructionHint: What the agent should do. The thread shows “automation started”, not the wording.
form.checklistHint: What the agent checks at every term.
form.kindFixed: The kind cannot be changed after creation.
form.monthDayHint: 1 to 28, so that every month has it.
form.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday – in the automation's time zone. At most every 15 minutes.
form.hoursHint: If “until” is before “from”, the active hours run past midnight; if both are equal, the whole day is active.
form.heartbeatOk: If the agent answers exactly HEARTBEAT_OK, it stays silent: nothing is delivered, only the log notes it.
form.quietHint: Within the quiet time at most one run starts; further events are counted and handed to the next run as a number.
form.eventRights: The run acts with your rights at the rule's place and writes only into this space.
form.eventSight: It reads only what a viewer of the space sees. Whoever causes the event gains no rights by it.
form.previewHint: In your local time; where different, the time in the automation's time zone.
form.previewWaiting: Appears once the schedule is complete.

errors.ticket: Please give a ticket number, such as HC-12.
errors.once: Please give a date and a time.

automation.not_found: This automation does not exist, or you may not see it.
automation.version_conflict: Someone has changed this automation in the meantime.
automation.not_allowed: You may not do that with this automation.
automation.owner_unable: Its owner may no longer run this automation. Whoever could create it can take it over.
automation.not_runnable: An event rule runs only when its event happens.
automation.limit: You already have as many automations as allowed. Delete one before creating another.
automation.kind_immutable: The kind of an automation cannot be changed.
automation.invalid_place: Not at this place: event rules need a channel or a ticket of a space.
automation.agent_not_member: The agent is not a member of this place's space.
automation.invalid_filter: This filter does not fit: tag and kind exist only for “ticket created”, and the tag must belong to the space.
automation.in_the_past: This time lies in the past.
automation.too_frequent: Too frequent: at least 15 minutes must lie between two terms.
automation.invalid_cron: We do not understand this cron expression. It needs five fields.
automation.invalid_interval: The interval must be between 15 and 1440 minutes.
automation.invalid_hours: These active hours do not fit.
